r9_rhp_technician.name: Sixten
pages:
Tried turning the battle off
and on again? No? Battle!
battle_won:
Fixed it. You were the bug.
Rest your team.
after:
Ledge down, then west
along the lane.

pages:
It hums the company jingle,
a little off-key.

Fresh bread, still warm.
Baked before the first shift.

Flowers for the desk, or for a
friend. Both brighten a day.

Fruit, greens and grain.
Eat well, work well. Have a look.

r9_rhp_archivist.name: Ebba
pages:
Every memo since the company began
is filed in here. Battle?
battle_won:
Filed under: won. Next!
Rest up and resubmit.
after:
Hop down the ledge.
The trail runs right below.
r9_rhp_archivist._name_note: Renamed from Ottilie: Ottilie is the Saltmere trail tide caller.

pages:
The top one says: please reply
to the memo below.

r9_rhp_gardener.name: Brita
pages:
The company closed this garden for
efficiency. I still water it.
battle_won:
Wilted, huh? Some water
and rest will fix that.

pages:
It says: OKAYEST MANAGER
IN THE WORLD.
